review.reason: The answer’s main capability categories are largely backed by the passages: standards coverage, FR1/FR2 ranges, SMBV100B bandwidth/calibration/GNSS, OTA SISO/MIMO/carrier aggregation, and CMX500 network emulation are all cited. It overreaches by naming NR NTN/NB-IoT NTN and making a few broad trend/requirement statements not explicitly supported, but these do not materially undermine the overall synthesis.
